principle: provider credentials and execution remain server-side and proof-specific

providers.promotion_proof: fresh provider-native dynamic-model-discovery exact-nonce semantic receipt
fresh private revision health/ready/handshake provider receipt
authenticated source-native retrieval plus provenance readback

fallback_rule: one provider failure must not fail the mission when another eligible route exists
private_data_rule: provider eligibility depends on data classification; availability alone is insufficient
